biggest_catch: Savings depend entirely on how much electricity you shift into the Sunday window — the discount applies only 11am–4pm Sundays (9am–5pm on the PeakSave Super Sunday tariff), so households that use little power on Sunday mornings save very little.
catches: The 50% discount applies only during the PeakSave window (11am–4pm Sundays on PeakSave Sundays; 9am–5pm on PeakSave Super Sunday tariff).
A working smart electricity meter is required.
Your daily standing charge is never discounted.
On PeakSave Sundays, the discount is capped at 60 kWh per Sunday session.
Switching to a PeakSave tariff is one-way — you cannot switch back to PeakSave Sundays.
Published average household saving up to 31 Aug 2026 ranges from £20 to £32 by region — savings are usage-driven, not guaranteed.

eligibility: British Gas electricity customers with a working smart meter. UK.
notes: Signup incentive (opt in via online account): 50% off electricity used in the Sunday off-peak window, credited to the bill. Average household saving published by British Gas is ~£31 (≈$41). Savings offset planned energy spending, never income.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (50% of unit rate × Sunday-window usage, capped 60 kWh/session; British Gas-published average household saving ~£31, converted at GBP→USD 1.334); time: online signup 15-30 min active

s1.note: You are a British Gas electricity customer with a working smart meter.

s2.note: Log into your online account and join PeakSave (or switch to a PeakSave Super Sunday tariff).

s3.note: Shift electricity use into the Sunday window (11am–4pm PeakSave Sundays; 9am–5pm PeakSave Super Sunday tariff).

s4.note: You pay for electricity as normal, then British Gas credits 50% back to your bill or meter.

s5.note: Credits are bill credits offsetting energy spending; not cash; standing charge not discounted.

s7.note: PeakSave Sundays can stay as an add-on; switching to a PeakSave tariff is one-way.

steps: As a British Gas electricity customer with a working smart meter, log into your online account.
Join PeakSave or switch to a PeakSave Super Sunday tariff.
Shift electricity use into the Sunday off-peak window.
British Gas credits 50% of the Sunday-window cost back to your bill or meter.
timing: Credits are applied to your bill or meter after each Sunday session; a monthly summary shows your savings.
